mapper.select: SELECT compcode, empnum, pw, name, role, status, CASE WHEN lock_until > SYSDATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS locked FROM test_emp WHERE compcode = #{compcode} AND empnum = #{empnum}
mapper.update: UPDATE test_emp SET lock_until = CASE WHEN fail_count + 1 >= 5 THEN SYSDATE + 10/1440 ELSE lock_until END, fail_count = CASE WHEN fail_count + 1 >= 5 THEN 0 ELSE fail_count + 1 END WHERE compcode = #{compcode} AND empnum = #{empnum}
